messages:
Devon: heads-up — e2e perf gate failed on master for build 1754c9a.
ci-bot: e2e_perf/throughput_and_latency failed gate check. p95 increased ~38% vs baseline. Dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/d/abcd
Marta: ugh. which change likely? any recent batching / kv-cache PRs?
Samir: PR #1832 touched the scheduler batching + kv-cache warmup logic, cc @Marta.
Marta: can someone rerun CI with extra warmup? cold KV cache tends to skew p99.
Devon: rerunning now with warmup flag. command: ```./scripts/ci/run_e2e.sh --sha 1754c9a --suite throughput_and_latency --warmup-tokens=5000```
ci-bot: rerun queued (job id 8921). ETA ~12m.
Ava: if rerun still fails, please request a bisect across the last 5 commits. I can kick it off.
Samir: yes please bisect. also grab the p99 traces and a couple of example request ids from Jaeger.
Ava: kicked off bisect: `infra/bisect-e2e.sh --range 1754a00..1754c9a --suite throughput_and_latency` -> https://ci.redwood.internal/bisect/8922
Devon: local repro hint: `python tools/e2e_runner.py --model llama --length 1024 --kv-warmup 1 --warmup-tokens 5000` and set `REDWOOD_CACHE=1`. helps narrow down cache-warmup behaviour.
Marta: copy. if bisect points at #1832 we should revert and ship a minimal hotfix for warmup (don't want to degrade latency in prod).
ci-bot: bisect job completed: culprit commit 1754b6f (PR #1832). Marking build red.
Samir: confirmed locally. rolling back PR #1832 on master now and opening a hotfix branch to rework kv-warmup.
Devon: after the revert please run the warmup-rerun CI. if green we cut a patch.
Ava: revert pushed, rerun started (job 8930).
ci-bot: rerun completed: all e2e perf gates passed. Closing thread. :tada:
Marta: great work team — will add regression test for warmup tokens and leave notes on #1832 about the expected warmup behaviour.
